name: wan-huiyan-cutify-this
description: cutify-this — a bundle of cute web skills. Cutify the browser tab (hand-authored SVG favicons) and sparkle up the whole page (fairy cursor, sparkle trails, scroll progress, confetti, floaters).

plugins.name: cutify-that-tab
plugins.description: Add a cute SVG favicon: emoji, gradient blob, or 16×16 pixel-art mascot. 56 pixel-art mascots + 22 emotion gradient blobs.

plugins.name: sparkle-that-page
plugins.description: Cute zero-dep page effects: fairy-wand cursor, sparkle trail, animated scroll-depth indicator, tab-title peekaboo, click confetti, ambient floaters, cute-chrome touches. Pixel-art variant on each.
